answers.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_base_units) / 1000000.0 AS value FROM events WHERE chain_id = 1 AND block_number >= 20000000 AND block_number <= 20000031 AND sender != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' AND recipient != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'

SELECT SUM(max_amount) / 1000000.0 AS value FROM (SELECT MAX(amount_base_units) AS max_amount FROM events WHERE chain_id = 1 AND block_number >= 20000000 AND block_number <= 20000031 AND sender != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' AND recipient != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' GROUP BY tx_id)

SELECT (all_val - max_val) AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_base_units) / 1000000.0 FROM events WHERE chain_id = 1 AND block_number >= 20000000 AND block_number <= 20000031 AND sender != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' AND recipient != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000') AS all_val, (SELECT SUM(max_amount) / 1000000.0 FROM (SELECT MAX(amount_base_units) AS max_amount FROM events WHERE chain_id = 1 AND block_number >= 20000000 AND block_number <= 20000031 AND sender != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' AND recipient != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' GROUP BY tx_id)) AS max_val)
